text:
Maria: Starting evening change window for translations-service v3.2.0 at 18:00 UTC. Canary 5% for 8m -> 20% for 12m. Preflight passed but keep an eye on the SLO dashboard and the translate/stream endpoint.

deploy-bot: Preflight OK: infra=green, model-cache=warm, cfg-checks=pass. Baseline p95=110ms, error_budget=22%. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/translations/overview

Ravi: Watching p95, tail-latency, and 5xx on /v1/translate/stream. Subscribed to alerts.

Tess: Noted autoscaler alert: node-pool usage creeping to 78% on us-west. Might want to hold if 90%+ or if queue depth rises.

ops-bot: Canary policy: pause if 5xx_rate >= 0.004 (0.4%) sustained 5m OR p95 > 650ms sustained 5m. Will auto-pause if triggered.

Ravi: Seeing a small 5xx blip, 0.28% over 3m around 1718000026. p95 holds ~160ms. Keeping watch.

Maria: Keep slices running for now. If it crosses ops-bot thresholds, pause and we'll triage.

ops-bot: Alert: TRANSLATE_STREAM_5XX_RATE > 0.004 (5m window) at 1718000042. Link: https://alerts.redwood.example/alerts/ALRT-4489

Tess: Pausing promotion. Im freezing traffic shift to further slices.

deploy-bot: Traffic promotion paused for translations-service v3.2.0 at 1718000045.

Ravi: Running quick diffs between v3.2.0 and v3.1.7 for handler timeouts and retry backoff changes. Found a change in retry policy: default retries increased from 1->2 for upstreams — could be stressing upstream translate workers.

Maria: Good catch. Can we patch back the retry change on the canary slice? If not, rollback slice. Ops, prepare rollback command.

Tess: Attempting hotfix: applying override config to canary slice to reset retries=1. Pushing config now.

deploy-bot: Config apply accepted to slice canary-02 at 1718000056. Will observe for 2m.

Ravi: After config override, 5xx dropped to 0.09% and p95 to 125ms at 1718000064. Looks stable.

Nora: Notifying product and CS: short blip during canary, mitigated by config revert. Filing note for release notes and post-deploy follow-up.

Maria: Thanks. We'll keep rollout paused for an additional 10m and then resume if stable. Assign follow-ups to eng-runtime to evaluate retry defaults and to capacity for pre-warm.

ops-bot: Incident stub created: INC-2025-0022 (link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2025-0022).

Tess: Suggestion: add a quick preflight diff check for retry/backoff changes in future deploys (automated).

Maria: Agreed. Add to release checklist. Closing thread once we've resumed or rolled back.
